title: UPS Battery and Runtime Health
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nut:ups
| stats latest(battery_charge_pct) as charge, latest(runtime_s) as runtime_s, latest(status) as status by ups_name
| eval runtime_min=round(runtime_s/60,1)
| where status!="OL" OR charge<50 OR runtime_min<10
| sort runtime_min
description: Monitors your battery backup for mains-power loss, a weak battery, or a shrinking runtime so it can actually protect your gear when it matters.
value: A UPS with a worn battery gives a false sense of safety; checking charge and runtime ensures it survives the next power cut.
implementation: Forward NUT UPS status; schedule every few minutes and alert on power loss, low charge, or degraded runtime.
visualization: Table of UPS units by charge, runtime, and status.
grandmaExplanation: It checks the backup battery for your home server so it can actually keep things running during a power cut.
